mathematical_definition: Bar count since the most recent CUSUM changepoint, where a changepoint is a bar at which both cusum_pos==0 and cusum_neg==0 (i.e. the CUSUM accumulator reset on the prior bar, using the same cusum_k-parameterized threshold as cusum_distance_to_threshold; bar 0 is never itself a changepoint). NaN before the first changepoint is observed. Also exposed internally (not registered) as `_bars_since_last_changepoint_internal` for reuse by family I (regime_state.py, Task 13) to avoid recomputing the CUSUM loop
numerical_stability_notes: Computed via a plain sequential Python for-loop (not numba-jitted) -- O(n) single pass but with Python-level per-bar overhead
missing_value_policy: NaN for every bar before the first CUSUM changepoint is observed (data-dependent, not a fixed warmup count); never zero-filled
status_reason: Not a v3 survivor (research/output/v3_feature_survivors.json): catboost_importance=0.002 (<0.3), MI rank 62 (outside top 15). catboost_importance=0.002, mi_rank=62, family=C_jump_change. Kept registered per spec section 9 -- Phase 4 may find it useful for a different target.
